title: Care-Team Question Backlog
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:ops question_type=* response_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(response_state!="answered",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by question_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending care-team questions backlog by question type for care coordination.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside care coordination.
implementation: Mark each `health:ops` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `question_type`.
visualization: Table of question type with pending care-team questions counts.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges where unfinished care-team questions are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in care coordination.
